seoTitle: Join Capital Row: a founding group of M&A advisors
seoDescription: For experienced M&A advisors: spend more time dealmaking and less time originating, with the intelligence, marketing and operating support behind your practice.

items.text: Spend more time dealmaking. Less time originating.

You bring transaction experience, sector knowledge and the judgment clients rely on. Capital Row brings the intelligence, marketing and operating support behind your practice. We are inviting a founding group of experienced advisors to help build a firm focused on vertical software and software-enabled businesses.

Capital Row is the M&A firm for vertical software and software-enabled businesses. We run the origination: sector research, outreach and qualification, so your time goes to clients, negotiations and execution.
Buyer research, acquisition criteria and company profiles, mapped in the sectors you know.
Outreach under the Capital Row name
Campaigns to owners and buyers, planned with you and run every week.
Conversations screened before they reach you, then tracked until they close or stop.
You start with the sector, the buyers and the companies already mapped.
A steady flow of owner and buyer conversations, without running the campaigns yourself.
Your time goes to the conversations most likely to become engagements.
The systems behind your practice, ready on day one.
A shared CRM, follow-up processes, engagement tracking and templates that keep work moving.
Configured analysis tools and documented calculations, with professional review where an engagement includes it.
A brand that expands your presence.
A professional advisor profile, sector content, social post drafts and campaign support that honor your expertise and extend your reach. You approve what goes out under your name.
You bring the judgment. We bring the flywheel.
Founding advisors bring transaction judgment and relationships. Capital Row brings the origination, intelligence and experience that keep a pipeline moving.
You have taken engagements from first conversation to close.
Owners, buyers or investors in software or software-enabled industries who take your call.
You work deals with shared research, materials and coordination.
Sector research, outreach and qualification running every week, so introductions keep coming.
Buyer maps, company profiles and deal materials prepared for each engagement.
Transaction and operating experience on each engagement, with professional review where the work calls for it.
Software operating or corporate development experience counts too.
Have an established practice name? We welcome conversations about keeping your identity while affiliating with Capital Row.
Affiliate with Capital Row under your own practice name, with branding rules agreed in writing.
Selected advisors can develop a distinct practice brand, with ownership, licensing and any future purchase rights agreed in writing.
A defined split of collected advisory fees and a monthly platform fee for included services. We walk through the terms in a confidential conversation, and they are set out in writing before you join.
Do I have to leave my current firm to talk?
No. Tell us about any commitments you have today, and we will respect them in every conversation.
Who keeps my clients and contacts if I leave?
Client attribution and departure terms are agreed in writing before you join, so both sides know the answer from the start.

Origination support, research, a shared CRM and workflows, financial preparation tools, marketing support and execution help matched to each engagement. A written support schedule sets out who does what, how often and at whose expense.
We are building with a founding group. Each service is in place before a founding advisor pays for it.
Tell us about your sector, your transaction experience and the support that would make the greatest difference to your practice.
A confidential 30-minute conversation. Nothing to prepare.
Capital Row is an independent advisory firm. Affiliation, compensation and brand terms are agreed in writing before any advisor joins.
